short: A British super-dreadnought battleship that served as Admiral John Jellicoe's flagship during the pivotal Battle of Jutland.
full:
Commissioned in March 1914, HMS Iron Duke was the lead ship of her class of super-dreadnoughts, armed with ten 13.5-inch guns and an improved secondary battery to counter torpedo boats. She became the flagship of the Grand Fleet upon the outbreak of the First World War under Admiral Sir John Jellicoe.

Her most famous action came at the Battle of Jutland in May 1916, where she scored multiple hits on the German dreadnought SMS König while taking almost no damage herself. She remained in active service until 1931, when the London Naval Treaty mandated her demilitarisation. She subsequently served as a gunnery training vessel and a depot ship in Scapa Flow during the Second World War, before finally being scrapped in 1946.
